violations.violation_type: Dual-Homed Host Bridging Level 3 and Level 1
violations.title: Dual-Homed Host Bridging Level 3 and Level 1 Directly
violations.description: Engineering Workstation EWS-01-ENG has two network interfaces: one on the Level 3 engineering network (192.168.30.50) and a second physical adapter connected directly into the Level 1 PLC subnet (192.168.10.99), completely bypassing Level 2 supervisory firewalls.
violations.remediation: Remove the secondary physical Ethernet interface from EWS-01-ENG. Require all engineering programming sessions to traverse a strictly brokered and authenticated jump host in Level 3.5.

violations.violation_type: Safety-Critical PLC Key Switch Left in REMOTE Position
violations.title: Critical Intake PLC Key Switch Left in REMOTE Position
violations.description: Primary controller PLC-01-MAIN has its physical hardware key switch positioned in 'REMOTE RUN' (REM). This allows unauthenticated network users with CIP access to upload modified ladder logic, download program changes, or force I/O without physical plant access.
violations.remediation: Instruct control room shift technician to rotate the physical chassis key switch to 'RUN' (hardware memory write protect). Store the physical key in a locked master lockbox.

violations.title: Uninspected Cleartext HTTP Admin Enabled on Core Industrial Switch
violations.description: Core switch SW-01-IND has an active HTTP server on TCP port 80 enabled for web management across the supervisory zone without TLS encryption.
violations.remediation: Disable HTTP web administration via switch CLI: `no ip http server` and enforce SSHv2 / HTTPS-only management with strong ciphers.

advisories.title: Rockwell Automation Logix Controllers CIP User Program Modification
advisories.description: A vulnerability exists in Logix 5580 controllers that allows an authenticated attacker to alter executable user ladder logic code without triggering an unauthorized program change alert.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade to firmware version 34.011 or later. If upgrading is delayed, rotate the physical controller key switch to RUN mode to physically disable program modifications.
recommended_compensating_controls: Physical Key Switch Locked to RUN
Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) Firewall / Zone Conduit Filter

advisories.title: Rockwell Automation Logix Controllers Unauthenticated CIP Authentication Bypass
advisories.description: The secret cryptographic signing key used to authenticate CIP connections was extracted, allowing attackers to forge trusted communication and upload malicious controller code.
advisories.remediation: Deploy CIP Security (TLS/DTLS) with FactoryTalk Policy Manager, or restrict port 44818 at industrial firewall boundaries.
recommended_compensating_controls: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) Firewall / Zone Conduit Filter
Dedicated Isolated VLAN / OT Port Security
Physical Key Switch Locked to RUN

advisories.title: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1200 / S7-1500 Memory Protection Bypass
advisories.description: A memory protection bypass allows an attacker with write access to copy arbitrary code into protected CPU memory areas and execute native machine code on the PLC.
advisories.remediation: Update S7-1500 CPU firmware to V2.9.2 or later. Implement access protection passwords in TIA Portal.
recommended_compensating_controls: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) Firewall / Zone Conduit Filter
Physical Key Switch Locked to RUN

advisories.title: Treck TCP/IP Stack Ripple20 Remote Code Execution in Embedded Devices
advisories.description: Improper handling of incoming IPv4 packet fragments allows an unauthenticated network adversary to trigger remote code execution or fatal device reboot.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade SEL RTAC firmware to version R150 or later. Block malformed IP fragments at perimeter firewalls.
recommended_compensating_controls: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) Firewall / Zone Conduit Filter

advisories.title: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 & SIPROTEC Global Cryptographic Key Extraction
advisories.description: Researchers extracted the internal symmetric hardware key protecting Siemens communications, enabling decryption and spoofing of firmware packets.
advisories.remediation: Apply Siemens DIGSI V09 update which transitions to individual TLS device certificates.
recommended_compensating_controls: Dedicated Isolated VLAN / OT Port Security
Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) Firewall / Zone Conduit Filter

advisories.title: Rockwell Automation 1756-EN2T Ethernet Communication Module Denial of Service
advisories.description: Specially crafted CIP requests to the 1756-EN2T bridge cause the communication stack to lock up, severing all HMI and SCADA polling to the PLC rack.
advisories.remediation: Update 1756-EN2T firmware to version 5.030 or later.
recommended_compensating_controls: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) Firewall / Zone Conduit Filter
